questions.prompt: The measurement countdown is running. What should happen to the shafts and measuring units?
questions.explanation: The countdown indicates active recording. Movement would distort the measurement.

reviewCue.text: Find the passage below on the review slide. Focus on the component, condition, or relationship it describes.

questions.prompt: A laser measuring unit shifts after setup. What must happen before accurate measurements can continue?
questions.answer: Secure it and recalibrate before continuing
options: Secure it and recalibrate before continuing
Ignore the movement if the beam is visible
questions.explanation: A shifted sensor affects measurement accuracy even if the beam still appears in range.

questions.prompt: Why make vertical corrections before horizontal fine alignment?
questions.answer: Adding or removing shims can disturb horizontal alignment
options: Adding or removing shims can disturb horizontal alignment
questions.explanation: The guide emphasizes vertical first because shim changes can disturb the horizontal setting.
